observations: Blue gas cylinder with a black hexagonal wire mesh shroud.
A burner assembly is attached to the top of the cylinder.
The burner is mounted on a black circular metal stand.
The valve is a brass-colored manual control valve.
The cylinder has a yellow logo on the side, but the text is too blurry to read.
The burner head shows some signs of use and discoloration.

claims.evidence: The cylinder shows some surface wear and discoloration on the burner head, but the overall condition is not clearly visible.
The age of the cylinder cannot be determined from photos.
Photo 0 shows the burner attached to the cylinder.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be past its expiry or re-qualification date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturing or expiry date stamped on the handle or collar.

risks.risk: The burner may be non-functional or have a faulty ignition.
risks.proof: A video showing the burner lit and burning steadily.

risks.risk: The valve may leak or have a stuck handle.
risks.proof: A video showing the valve being opened and closed while under pressure.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturing or expiry date stamped on the cylinder handle or collar.
Video of the burner lit and burning.
Photo of the valve being operated to confirm it is not leaking.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
